svg.title: Detection center to a session-local native spatial anchor
svg.desc: A calibrated ray through the detected box center hits environment depth. A native spatial anchor is created once at that point. Label position remains under the anchor while only its child text rotates to face the viewer. Labels are not recreated from subsequent detections.
svg.text: A center-depth hit becomes a stable label location
Native 0.3.0 · Environment depth → OVRSpatialAnchor → label-only first-person AR
Calibrated ray through the detected center
Create the anchor once at P
Only child text rotates; root is not head-driven
Later matching detections update confidence and last-seen time — never the anchor's position.
Session-local location retention, not moving-object tracking or saved cross-relaunch anchors.
